summary: Shows creating a Windows Server 2016 VM with vagrant init jborean93/WindowsServer2016 and vagrant up, which runs sysprep and sets up HTTP and HTTPS WinRM listeners automatically.
questions: How do I spin up a Windows Server VM ready for Ansible?
Does the Vagrant Windows box configure WinRM for me?

answer_card.title: Create a Windows Server VM
answer_card.answer_md:
```shell
vagrant init jborean93/WindowsServer2016
vagrant up
```
On first boot it runs sysprep and creates HTTP and HTTPS WinRM listeners; Vagrant finishes once they're up.
